title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Payer, Billing Method and Goodwill Authority Schedule
content:
This schedule of the network billing office states, for each ADAS Sensor Calibrations tier, whether an insurer's glass program may be billed, whether an insurance claim repair needs the insurer's approval of the calibration, how warranty rework calibrations are billed, whether customer-pay dealer sublets are capped, which payment methods are accepted from the customer, and the goodwill credit authority per order.

## Schedule

| Term | Dynamic Camera Calibration | Static Camera Calibration | Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | Blind Spot Radar Calibration | Front Radar Calibration | Multi-System Calibration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calibration may be billed to an insurer's glass program when it follows a glass claim replacement | yes | yes | yes | no | no | yes |
| Calibration on an insurance claim repair needs the insurer's approval of the calibration on that repair order before it is attempted | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Billing of a calibration ordered for warranty rework | no charge (absorbed by the network) | no charge (absorbed by the network) | no charge (absorbed by the network) | no charge (absorbed by the network) | no charge (absorbed by the network) | no charge (absorbed by the network) |
| Customer-pay order sublet to a dealer is charged no more than the tier's calibration price | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Payment methods accepted from the customer | card, cash, check | card, cash, check | card, cash, check | card, cash, check | card, cash, check | card, cash, check |
| Goodwill credit authority: most the desk may write off as goodwill on one order, USD | 25.00 | 35.00 | 45.00 | 35.00 | 45.00 | 90.00 |

## Points of judgement read from the schedule

- **Glass program billing.** Blind Spot Radar Calibration and Front Radar Calibration show "no" for glass program billing; the other four tiers show "yes".
- **Insurer approval.** Every tier shows "yes": on every tier, a calibration on an insurance claim repair needs the insurer's approval of the calibration on that repair order before it is attempted.
- **Warranty rework.** Every tier bills a calibration ordered for warranty rework as no charge, absorbed by the network.
- **Payment methods.** The methods accepted from the customer are card, cash and check on every tier; remittance does not appear among them.
- **Goodwill authority.** The authority runs from 25.00 USD (Dynamic Camera Calibration) to 90.00 USD (Multi-System Calibration); Static Camera Calibration and Blind Spot Radar Calibration share 35.00 USD, and Dual-Mode Camera Calibration and Front Radar Calibration share 45.00 USD.
